gloss: precisely because; it is exactly because

definitions.gloss: precisely because; it is exactly because
definitions.explanation: Compound particle that emphatically asserts the reason for something. Combines the cause-marker から with the emphasis particle こそ, conveying 'this and no other is the reason'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧からこそ、⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}い→追う：02016_ou⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It was precisely because my family understood me that I could keep chasing my dream.

examples.japanese: ⟦{君|きみ}→君：01384_kimi⟧だからこそ⟦{頼|たの}みたい→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: It's precisely because it's you that I want to ask.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦労|くろう}した→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧からこそ、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}できる→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
examples.english: It's precisely because I struggled that I can appreciate my present success.

notes:
Emphatic version of ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (because). The ⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧ singles out the stated reason as the decisive one, often implying that this — and not some other plausible cause — is the true reason. Common in heartfelt speech, motivational writing, and arguments where the speaker is pushing back on an alternative reading.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [Verb / i-adj plain] + からこそ
- Noun / na-adj stem + だ + からこそ
- Often followed by 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ / ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧です to round off the emphasis (⟦{君|きみ}→君：01384_kimi⟧だからこそ⟦{頼|たの}める→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- から: because — neutral cause; no emphasis
- ⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: precisely because — emphasizes a heightened result from the cause
- ば⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧: precisely because — literary equivalent of からこそ
- だからこそ: precisely because (sentence-initial) — same logic at the start of a new sentence
